selected_meaning: The place in a store where purchases are paid for.
exact_brief: Show a complete staffed checkout lane: customer side, short goods belt or counter, and a register, with a shopper presenting purchases. Frame the lane as one place while the equipment stays subordinate. Reject a close-up of a register alone, a help desk, or a hotel reception. No readable payment credentials or brand marks.

working_brief.audience: Professional English vocabulary learners using the existing phone-size Match and Memory cards
working_brief.action: Recognize the place in a store where purchases are paid for
working_brief.visual_language: Existing soft low-poly Kenney production sources, original materials, restrained studio lighting, no labels
working_brief.target: Actual Match 126x72 (picture 102x52) and Memory 144x74 (picture 120x54), including the actual badge and matched 0.68 picture alpha

diagnosis: An isolated counter or register cannot establish the payment-area sense. A complete belt-and-terminal station, two clearly related roles, and a few groceries should identify one staffed checkout lane; every subordinate element must remain subordinate at native phone size.
focal_subject: One complete checkout station and the space connecting a staff member behind the terminal with a shopper beside the goods belt.
proposed_composition: Use the complete Mini Market cash-register station at its original root scale.
Place the green-and-white employee behind the terminal and the yellow-top shopper beside the goods belt, facing the same transaction area.
Place one complete carton and one complete apple on the belt, scaled uniformly to remain groceries rather than focal icons.
Compare one compact transparent group with one group on four complete original floor tiles; use the floor only if the lane remains legible at card size.
Sample only the included static, idle or interact-right character clips. Confirm the sampled poses visually before rendering a candidate. No hand-authored joint posing.
Use a camera that preserves the belt, terminal, both character roles and customer space without hiding faces or purchases. Keep all brand marks and credentials absent.

compare_against.counter: Broad customer-serving surface with a small sealed parcel; no payment apparatus or staff/shopper interaction.
compare_against.cash_register: One machine with physical keys and drawer base, excluded from this whole-lane picture.
compare_against.checkout: Whole staffed payment place with store goods and a customer side.

reject_if: The scene reads as a help desk, table, hotel reception, two unrelated characters, or a generic shop.
Belt/groceries or staff/customer distinction disappear at 102x52.
The shopper pose floats, intersects the station, or suggests an unrelated action.
Source floor lowers scale so far that the checkout cannot be recognized.
Any mesh/material/texture substitution, readable labels, credentials or branding appears.
sequence: Native original-source and included-pose inspection after root grants a slot.
Review those rendered sources before authorizing composition probe.
Run compact and tiled lane compositions, then choose only if actual WordCard states retain the intended sense.
Independent image review and production handoff remain later steps owned by root.
scope: Scratch preparation only. No production, test, curriculum, language, morphology or readiness edits. No native rendering has run.
